2016.emphasis_summary: Only two sections are populated, both audit and governance boilerplate (auditor independence, pre-approval policies and the ethics and compliance officer role), with no diversity, environment or human-capital text captured.

2017.emphasis_summary: The excerpts introduce a Sustainability and Citizenship Highlights summary (proxy access, codes of conduct, written ethics policies) and a quality-compliance modifier in annual incentive pay that can reduce payouts.

2018.emphasis_summary: Quality and product stewardship lead, citing a Global Human Rights program and a Responsible Supply Management program launched in the past two years, alongside growth-catalyst and therapy-innovation language.

2019.emphasis_summary: Quality and therapy innovation lead, with the 'We emphasize quality' annual-incentive modifier and a Product Stewardship program added to the human-rights and supply-management programs.
2019.notable_shifts: The 2019 text adds Product Stewardship to the program list and sharpens the quality emphasis in pay, and R&D language rises further (about 23 to about 28 hits), while the human-capital section stays empty.

2020.emphasis_summary: A Sustainability and ESG Highlights summary leads, with a corporate-sustainability roadmap tied to the company Mission and the human-rights, supply-management and product-stewardship programs.

2021.emphasis_summary: The excerpts pair the quality-compliance modifier with diversity, noting that Board candidates are assessed on diversity of background, and a COVID-19 pandemic narrative runs through the filing.
2021.notable_shifts: The diversity section is populated for the first time (it was empty through 2020) and COVID-19 language grows from about 6 to about 22 hits.

2022.emphasis_summary: Inclusion, Diversity and Equity (ID&E) is elevated to a pay metric, with Quality and ID&E named as annual-incentive scorecard components and the DiversityInc Top 50 ranking (number 10) cited.

2023.emphasis_summary: ESG governance leads, describing a Sustainability Program Office that escalates material issues to a Sustainability Steering Committee, a carbon-neutrality-by-FY30 goal, and a DiversityInc ranking of number 2.
2023.notable_shifts: The DiversityInc ranking rises from number 10 to number 2, and the excerpts add the escalation mechanism for ESG issues (Sustainability Program Office to Steering Committee), while the compensation text repeats the 2022 Quality and ID&E scorecard language.

2024.emphasis_summary: ID&E and sustainability governance lead, with an annual public ID&E report and a Sustainability Program Office that tracks risks across short-, medium- and long-term horizons, alongside the Quality and ID&E scorecard.
2024.notable_shifts: The 2024 text adds the time-horizon framing for sustainability risks and the annual public ID&E report, while the scorecard language is repeated from 2023.
